welcome.title:
Eight moments.
One real day.
welcome.body: You deserve to be you. The easiest way to tell your story, one real day at a time.

1.title: Eight moments a day

2.title: Every moment fills your jar
2.body: Eight moments make a full jar. A fresh jar starts every midnight, and missed a moment? You can fill it in later. Every jar is kept in My days.

3.title: You deserve to be you.
3.body: The easiest way to tell your story. No pretending, no pressure: just your day as it happens, shared with the people you choose.

help.title: Help & feedback
help.noResults: No questions match “{{query}}”. Try another word, or message us below.

faq.q: How do jars and moments work?
faq.a: Each day gets one jar with eight slots: where you are, what you’re busy with, who you’re with, your outfit, a selfie, and your morning, afternoon and evening. Fill a slot with one photo, a moment. A new jar starts at your local midnight.

faq.q: Why does a moment say “Added later”?
faq.a: A moment added after its day ended, from your gallery or with Fill this jar, carries an “Added later” badge. Pickld’s server decides this from its own clock, not your phone’s.
You choose for each jar: Readers (people who read you), Everyone, or Only me. Private moments are never shown to anyone else, in any jar. Set the default in Settings.
Today’s jar keeps the time zone it started in until it closes. Your next jar starts at the new local midnight, and a one-time banner explains the switch.

faq.q: How do I get my sticker packs on a new phone?
faq.a: Sign in with the same account, then open Settings → My stickers and tap Restore. Packs you bought come back; earned and free packs are always there.
